v3.fact: DeviceInfo entry is used only as archive recognition; output device=None. Profiles receive performance=None. Feature XML without a <Mappings substring is skipped, including DPI, DPIStages, polling and power.
DKM_M_03/04 become Naga thumb_03/04; DKM_SB_03 is dropped with a warning.
Only KeyGroup, MouseGroup and MacroGroup are recognized; SensitivityGroup and unknown groups become Disabled. raw_mapping=None prevents downstream recovery or exact unknown-field detection.
Only boolean modifier families survive; original right/left modifier and full raw source options are not retained.

v4.fact: Serde mirrors do not retain unknown fields. Extra profile features, nested keyboard options and per-stage visibility/index/count metadata can disappear before app conversion. raw_mapping serializes the restricted mirror rather than the original JSON.

The shared Naga mapping dictionary is reused. Bottom DPI alias is dropped; side aliases get Naga control IDs. Some outputs are explicitly Unmappable, but their missing raw group fields cannot be reconstructed downstream.

envelope.fact: Official UI processData reads productId/category and profiles/macros envelopes. decodeDataObject base64-decodes payload, parses JSON, verifies checksum, and applies the envelope name.

checksum.fact: MD5 of recursively sorted-key JSON after removing root hash and gamemode. An integrity checksum, not a signature or device identity. Original implementation checked against standard vectors and the retained MIT public export.

dpi.fact: XML DPIStages.Active becomes JSON active=Active+1. Rows preserve XY, independent, visible from per-row Active, and zero-based index. Exact model default JSON active3 corresponds to XML/native active2. Hidden/reordered/disabled/inconsistent tables block.

model_defaults.fact: Exact182 declares vendor5426, product182, dongle183, MOUSE. Default JSON has mappings=[] and five visible stages. Retained XML supplies both layers of eight exact physical input defaults.
model_defaults.limit: These facts do not prove sparse export/application merge semantics. No automatic default expansion is enabled.

mapping_bridge.fact: XML MappingGroup selects keyboard/mouse/sensitivity/disable/media/Hypershift/macro groups. Keyboard bridge retains key token, category and modifier metadata. Full object-form modifiers, turbo and unsupported source options remain blocked.

media.fact: Seven supported names: NextTrack, PrevTrack, MediaStop, Play, MuteVolume, VolumeUp, VolumeDown. Other media names remain unsupported.
